text:
Julio, after I left in tears
        the one from whom my thoughts never part,
        and left that part of my soul
        which gave the body life and strength,


        I take a strict account of my own good,
        and, being so afflicted, all good fails me,
        so that I fear in part
        even breath will fail me as I sigh;


        and with this fear my tongue tries
        to speak with you, O sweet friend,
        of that day's bitter memory,


        when I began, as witness,
        to be able to bring you news of your soul,
        and to learn from you of mine.

translation.title: Julio, after I left in tears
translation.editorial_note: Imported as a translation without separate editorial review.
